topic: Longest coastline: Canada 202,080 km (CIA World Factbook), Indonesia 54,716 km, Russia 37,653 km; Canada has 52,455 islands (Statistics Canada); Pacific, Arctic and Atlantic coasts.
policy_note: Every spoken or shown fact → a claim with ≥ 2 independent publishers; core claims need a primary/scholarly source.

myths.myth: Russia has the longest coastline because it is the biggest country.
myths.reality: Russia's coastline is about 37,653 km; Canada's is 202,080 km, more than five times longer, because of its Arctic archipelago.

guardrails.why: Contested name — say 'the Gulf' or use both names (docs/BORDER_POLICY.md).
